title: RDKit Molecular Similarity Search
summary: Rank molecules in your supplied collection using Morgan radius 2, 2048 bits, chirality enabled and Tanimoto similarity. Query/hit drawings, exact scores and downloadable rankings; CPU only.
caveats: Morgan radius2, 2048 bits, includeChirality=True; Tanimoto on-bit intersection/union.
No desalt, neutralization or tautomer standardization; preserve all fragments.
Keep all duplicates; ties by descending score, exact Unicode ID then row index.
Structural similarity does not establish potency, activity, toxicity, safety or patent status.
A score of 1 is not identity; exact_match uses canonical isomeric SMILES.
Parity and demonstrations are software verification, not broad biological validation.
